gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squar: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. But beneath Flavors, with its whimsical heft, extended reading would go down in a friendly, approachable way.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-numans: Expressive Autour One runs with a pen-plotter smoothness and almost no step from capitals to lowercase. Numans, modern and clean, spaces its letters far apart, which gives the heading's roundness a tidy partner.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads clearly at small sizes, its round letters open and its lowercase sturdy and tall. And Audiowide, with its tile-like glyphs and pencil-line consistency, gives that plain sans body a futuristic front door.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan reads approachably, with plenty of daylight inside its curves and a hefty, solid lowercase body. Above it, Eater adds dark, aggressive hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding Tilt Neon draws a tube-like stroke of constant width, with zero contrast anywhere. Bespoke Sans, sharp and sans-serif, leaves generous room between curve ends and the stem, giving the loud heading a precise counterweight.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee reads approachably, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its mean line set high. Below Tilt Neon, whole paragraphs of it stay gentle on the eye, never tiring.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-aldrich: Bold Tilt Neon draws a tube-like, constant-width stroke with a large x-height. Aldrich, a professional plain sans with cupped round letters, makes extended text feel like tracing a single thick thread.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alexandria: Alexandria is a clean sans-serif, tall in the body with short stems above and below. But Tilt Neon has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet, so it takes the loud role and leaves the quiet one to its partner.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-bangla: Glowing tube letters: Tilt Neon keeps one fixed nib width from end to end. Anek Bangla, an approachable sans with wide s curves barely curled in, is the quiet strength of the pair.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-devanagari: Modern in feel, Anek Devanagari opens its letter mouths distinctly and keeps a tall middle zone to its lowercase. Tilt Neon, free of any calligraphic swelling, adds the loud headline on top.
